title: User Interfaces of the Demo Scene
excerpt: Exploring the tools of the trade
content_html:
Exploring the tools of the trade

July 2026

Ahh, the demo scene - a digital art subculture, a motley gang of creative nerds, and a favourite pastime of mine. So much amazing art, music and code has been produced by sceners, and anyone who comes into contact with the scene might start to wonder exactly how - apart from hours of dedicated grind, of course.

The scene has a long and storied tradition of building its own tools. Sometimes from scratch, sometimes by stealing ideas or even code from existing offerings. In a combination of teenage inexperience, old habits, a penchant for experimenting and a desire to make things look cool, this has resulted in some rather peculiar user interfaces.

A few of them are presented below. Most of them are for the Amiga, but several other platforms are represented as well.

Elite Sinus Producer

Not wanting to be accused of clickbaiting, let's start off with one of the main attractions: Elite Sinus Producer (sinus here is to be understood as sine), made by Ipec Elite for the Amiga. Demos are usually described as "real time", which is true in the sense that they're (almost) never just animation players, and that demo effects are produced, frame by frame, from code. However, to achieve seemingly impossible technical feats, extensive "cheating" is employed. The most common cheat is probably the so called precalc, meaning that instead of doing complex maths on a 7 MHz (or even slower) CPU, lookup tables are utilized. A plethora of tools for creating such lookup tables exist. This is one of them.

When first starting Elite Sinus Producer, the user is met with this menu. Upon pressing an F-key to make a selection, the corresponding menu option is highlighted and a sample of a cuckoo clock is played. Loudly.

Here I've selected the "Flower" option. Pretty, no? This can then be saved to disk as (presumably) assembly source code. Any sprite would look nice when moving along this path!

There's also a handy help screen, which is so outlandish I had to grab a short film clip of it: Part of the background consists of moving blue raster bars, and the other part flashes between red and cyan. This obviously helps immensely when reading the text, displayed in a font designed with nothing but legibility in mind.

Text Based Interfaces

Plenty of scene related tools are either command line utilities or predominantly text based. First out, we have the assemblers. There was a wide variety of assemblers for the Amiga, but the scene always favoured Seka, Asm-One and other derivatives of the same concept. There were so many different versions and hacks (Trash'm-one, for example) that the sprawling family tree rivals that of Unix systems.

Here's Seka 2.0, and as we can see, it's based on a commercial assembler. This type of assembler always asks the user for the size of the working memory to be allocated. They then enter a command line mode, which can be used to examine RAM memory and CPU registers, and load source files into the editor proper.

Here's AsmOne in one of its many incarnations. It's quite similar to Seka (in fact, it's "Seka-Updated"), but has more built-in commands and presumably other improvements as well (I've never been much of a coder). Interface-wise, it opens its own screen, as opposed to running in a window on the default Workbench screen.

What if you found a piece of cool music or graphics in, say, a game? What if you wanted to steal some samples, or a sprite, or perhaps just save an entire tune for easy listening? Then you'd need a ripper - a tool for hunting through your computer's memory, looking for remnants of such data after quitting the game. There were tons of various such rippers for the Amiga. Here's Multi-Ripper, which has a fairly representative set of features.

Here's another type of ripper, specifically written to look for Seka assembly sources in memory after the computer had crashed. The Amiga, like most other home computers, had no memory protection, and demo coding is a notoriously crash-prone activity. Saving often was common practice, but even seasoned coders sometimes messed up and forgot. With a bit of luck, the code could be extracted from memory after a warm reboot.

Here's another type of sine precalculator, called The Sinus Creator. I have no idea if the numbers I've entered in the screenshot make sense, but the two-window text interface is interesting. Of course, the result can be saved as a Seka source file.

Music Trackers

Demo music has historically been made in trackers. Far from traditional notation, a tracker lets the musician enter tones along with various modifiers and effects in something that's more reminiscent of a programming editor rather than regular composing. They also let the user manage instruments, whether sampled or synthesized.

Sample-based trackers on the Amiga have an even more sprawling family tree than that of Amiga assemblers, but they all originate from Karsten Obarski's commercial Ultimate Soundtracker from 1987. Being commercial and thus costing money, it was soon picked apart by sceners, which resulted in NoiseTracker, which was then revamped into ProTracker, which in turn exists in so many various versions and re-hashed hacks that it's nigh impossible to keep track (heh) of. The sprawl is even sprawlier than that of Amiga assemblers!

SoundMonitor 1.0 for the Commodore 64 (by Chris Huelsbeck) isn't strictly speaking a scene release, and wasn't called "tracker". However, the interface (with one "track" per available sound channel) is what inspired the previously mentioned Ultimate Soundtracker, and is thus included here for posterity and correctness.

NoiseTracker by the Swedish duo Mahoney and Kaktus wasn't the first, but it was immensely popular and came to define the tracker experience for years to come. Its legacy lives on just not in Protracker on the Amiga, but on several other platforms as well.

Here's Protracker's file picker. Just like in NoiseTracker above, it's accessed by clicking the "Disk Op." button in the rather dense interface. It's hard to describe what a strange experience this UI delivers, because it's almost - but not quite - intuitive to someone used to more mainstream Amiga programs. It's easy to misclick, misunderstand or just plain miss things. To illustrate its idiosyncratic design, take note of the vertical EXIT button, which quits back to the main menu. It's conveniently placed between the up and down arrows used for scrolling the purple file and directory listing.

Here's Digicomposer 1.0 for the Atari ST/e, which in turn builds on Noisetracker for the Atari. The interface is clearly more than just inspired by its Amiga counterpart. It's but one of a whole menagerie of trackers for the Atari ST, some "digi" (sample-based) like this one, some for YM-chip based music.

Fasttracker II for MS-DOS is iconic in its own right. With support for Gravis UltraSound and other advanced PC sound hardware, it has features for 16-bit samples, bizarre amounts of sound channels, and even lets the user play a simple version of Snake if they so desire.

Abyss' Highest Experience is a chiptune tracker for the Amiga, intended to sound like the Commodore 64's SID chip. The user interface is an interesting crossover between Soundtracker and a more modern, Workbench 2.0-like look.

I don't know much about Megatizer for the Atari ST, but it sure does look cool!

JamCrackerPro for the Amiga eschewed the traditional tracker UI and opted for a system-friendly, multi-window interface.

Disk Copiers

In order to distribute demos (and pirated software), disk copying was a common activity on the scene. Commodore provided a disk copier in AmigaOS, but it wasn't always up to the task of copying demos and games that bypassed the file system by writing directly to the tracks of a floppy. Thus, special software was needed!

Like SoundMonitor, X-Copy isn't strictly a scene release. Although originally written by sceners, it was released commercially and then heavily pirated on the scene. The prominently featured grids contain one square for each track on the disk, displaying the status for copying that particular part of the floppy. When a copy was finished (which could take some time), the program helpfully played a little "boing" sound.

X-Copy was released in many versions during the Amiga heydays. Here's X-Copy 3.0, apparently in an illicit variety distributed by the cracking group Paradox.

Personally, I preferred D-Copy, mostly because I thought the user interface looked cool (and I still do). It is, as far as I know, a bona fide non-commercial scene product.

Other Tools

A short article like this can only ever scratch the surface of the numerous demo scene tools ever created. Here are but a few more various tools and interfaces, selected for being interesting and/or representative of their kind.

This is Titanics Cruncher for the Amiga. A cruncher uses asymmetrical compression of executable files. This saves space on disk, with the tradeoff being longer loading times, due to the decrunching (decompression) of the executable upon running it. Several other crunchers exist, and on a variety of platforms.

Before the Internet, there was the Bulletin Board System, or BBS. Sceners were usually interested in Elite BBS:es, meaning ones that offered pirated software for download. There were few, if any, Elite BBS:es without cool ANSI (or PETSCII, on the C64) graphics, for example in animated menu screens. Thus, many various ANSI editors popped up for different platforms. This is Digital Intelligence's Ansi-Editor v2.4 for the Amiga, and it has a very peculiar user interface. The toolbar at the bottom displays the currently active colours, but you can't select them from there. Click all you want, to no effect - you have to use the pull-down menu to actually pick one.

Before Twitter, Facebook, IRC and even widespread access to modems and BBS:es, scroll texts were the communication medium of choice for the scene. Cool scrollers required cool fonts, and it could be helpful with a dedicated font (or charset) editor. Here's Charedit by Escape, for MS-DOS.

Home computers often came with custom or otherwise esoteric hardware. The Atari Falcon, for example, sported a Motorola 56001 digital signal processor. DSPdit by tSCc (short for The Sirius Cybernetics Corporation) is an editor and assembler made specifically for DSP56k programming. It uses the standard GEM toolkit, which gives it a very clean and professional look.

The first computer virus for the Amiga was a bootblock virus, infecting the boot sector of floppy disks. As such, it could potentially ruin games and other floppies with custom bootblocks. It was constructed by the Swiss Cracking Association, SCA. The virus spread like wildfire and perhaps SCA was plagued by a guilty conscience, because later they also produced the very first virus killer for the Amiga - designed to counter their own virus. The mega-mighty interface is easy enough to grasp!

As mentioned above, plenty of Amiga demos were so called trackmos, meaning they didn't use the file system, but rather stored data straight on the tracks of a floppy disk. This soon resulted in various tooling becoming available for creating such trackmos. Mostly it was just code shared between sceners, but there were also complete software suites, like TrackmoDOS by Poison of NOVA. Among other things, it came with this orthodox file manager for writing and deleting files to a trackmo floppy. Being a scener tool, the GUI of course sports some rather spiffy colour gradients.

This is RAW, which isn't really a tool, but rather a disk magazine, or diskmag. A diskmag is just that - a periodical published on one or more floppy disks. Most of the articles were usually scene related, although some mags branched out and featured everything from short stories and poems to essays about history and politics. RAW was one of the most popular Amiga diskmags during the early 1990s, and as we can see, the UI was shiny and textured long before Frutiger Aero was a thing. It even came with a built-in palette editor (pictured), allowing the user to customize the text colours.

This is FuckPaint, a pixel painter for the Atari Falcon. It is included here solely on the merit of its name, and its equally classy "Analizer" tool.

Although not at all a scene production, Deluxe Paint must be mentioned here. To the best of my knowledge, the scene never produced a pixel painter for the Amiga (except later ports of Grafx2), presumably because nobody saw the need for one. I don't think a single Amiga user existed that didn't have a copy of this software, either bought separately, bundled with the machine or just pirated. It was also completely dominant on the PC. There were other Amiga pixel painters, such as Brilliance and Personal Paint, but their combined market share was a mere fraction of this giant, which also dominated graphics creation for games well into the the mid-1990s.

That's enough demo scene interfaces for one helping. For those still wanting more, I recommend this gallery of utildisk menus.

Take care and happy hacking!

sentences.zh: 然后可以将其作为（大概）汇编源代码保存到磁盘。

blocks.html_en: Text Based Interfaces

sentences.en: Text Based Interfaces
sentences.zh: 基于文本的界面

blocks.html_en: Plenty of scene related tools are either command line utilities or predominantly text based. First out, we have the assemblers. There was a wide variety of assemblers for the Amiga, but the scene always favoured Seka, Asm-One and other derivatives of the same concept. There were so many different versions and hacks (Trash'm-one, for example) that the sprawling family tree rivals that of Unix systems.

sentences.en: Plenty of scene related tools are either command line utilities or predominantly text based.
sentences.zh: 许多场景相关工具要么是命令行实用程序，要么主要基于文本。

sentences.en: First out, we have the assemblers.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们有汇编器。

sentences.en: There was a wide variety of assemblers for the Amiga, but the scene always favoured Seka, Asm-One and other derivatives of the same concept.
sentences.zh: Amiga 有各种各样的汇编器，但现场总是青睐 Seka、Asm-One 和同一概念的其他衍生产品。

sentences.en: There were so many different versions and hacks (Trash'm-one, for example) that the sprawling family tree rivals that of Unix systems.
sentences.zh: 有如此多不同的版本和 hack（例如 Trash'm-one），其庞大的家谱可与 Unix 系统相媲美。

blocks.html_en: Here's Seka 2.0, and as we can see, it's based on a commercial assembler. This type of assembler always asks the user for the size of the working memory to be allocated. They then enter a command line mode, which can be used to examine RAM memory and CPU registers, and load source files into the editor proper.

sentences.en: Here's Seka 2.0, and as we can see, it's based on a commercial assembler.
sentences.zh: 这是 Seka 2.0，正如我们所看到的，它基于商业汇编器。

sentences.en: This type of assembler always asks the user for the size of the working memory to be allocated.
sentences.zh: 这种类型的汇编器总是询问用户要分配的工作内存的大小。

sentences.en: They then enter a command line mode, which can be used to examine RAM memory and CPU registers, and load source files into the editor proper.
sentences.zh: 然后，他们进入命令行模式，该模式可用于检查 RAM 内存和 CPU 寄存器，并将源文件加载到适当的编辑器中。

blocks.html_en: Here's AsmOne in one of its many incarnations. It's quite similar to Seka (in fact, it's "Seka-Updated"), but has more built-in commands and presumably other improvements as well (I've never been much of a coder). Interface-wise, it opens its own screen, as opposed to running in a window on the default Workbench screen.

sentences.en: Here's AsmOne in one of its many incarnations.
sentences.zh: 这是 AsmOne 的众多化身之一。

sentences.en: It's quite similar to Seka (in fact, it's "Seka-Updated"), but has more built-in commands and presumably other improvements as well (I've never been much of a coder).
sentences.zh: 它与 Seka 非常相似（事实上，它是“Seka-Updated”），但有更多内置命令，大概还有其他改进（我从来都不是一个编码员）。

sentences.en: Interface-wise, it opens its own screen, as opposed to running in a window on the default Workbench screen.
sentences.zh: 从界面角度来看，它会打开自己的屏幕，而不是在默认工作台屏幕上的窗口中运行。

blocks.html_en: What if you found a piece of cool music or graphics in, say, a game? What if you wanted to steal some samples, or a sprite, or perhaps just save an entire tune for easy listening? Then you'd need a ripper - a tool for hunting through your computer's memory, looking for remnants of such data after quitting the game. There were tons of various such rippers for the Amiga. Here's Multi-Ripper, which has a fairly representative set of features.

sentences.en: What if you found a piece of cool music or graphics in, say, a game?
sentences.zh: 如果您在游戏中发现一段很酷的音乐或图形怎么办？

sentences.en: What if you wanted to steal some samples, or a sprite, or perhaps just save an entire tune for easy listening?
sentences.zh: 如果您想窃取一些样本或精灵，或者只是保存整首曲子以便于聆听，该怎么办？

sentences.en: Then you'd need a ripper - a tool for hunting through your computer's memory, looking for remnants of such data after quitting the game.
sentences.zh: 然后你需要一个开膛手 - 一种在计算机内存中搜寻的工具，在退出游戏后寻找此类数据的残留物。

sentences.en: There were tons of various such rippers for the Amiga.
sentences.zh: Amiga 的此类撕裂器有很多。

sentences.en: Here's Multi-Ripper, which has a fairly representative set of features.
sentences.zh: 这是 Multi-Ripper，它具有一组相当有代表性的功能。

blocks.html_en: Here's another type of ripper, specifically written to look for Seka assembly sources in memory after the computer had crashed. The Amiga, like most other home computers, had no memory protection, and demo coding is a notoriously crash-prone activity. Saving often was common practice, but even seasoned coders sometimes messed up and forgot. With a bit of luck, the code could be extracted from memory after a warm reboot.

sentences.en: Here's another type of ripper, specifically written to look for Seka assembly sources in memory after the computer had crashed.
sentences.zh: 这是另一种类型的开膛手，专门为在计算机崩溃后在内存中查找 Seka 汇编源而编写。

sentences.en: The Amiga, like most other home computers, had no memory protection, and demo coding is a notoriously crash-prone activity.
sentences.zh: Amiga 与大多数其他家用电脑一样，没有内存保护，而且演示编码是出了名的容易崩溃的活动。

sentences.en: Saving often was common practice, but even seasoned coders sometimes messed up and forgot.
sentences.zh: 经常保存是常见的做法，但即使是经验丰富的程序员有时也会搞砸并忘记。

sentences.en: With a bit of luck, the code could be extracted from memory after a warm reboot.
sentences.zh: 运气好的话，在热重启后可以从内存中提取代码。

blocks.html_en: Here's another type of sine precalculator, called The Sinus Creator. I have no idea if the numbers I've entered in the screenshot make sense, but the two-window text interface is interesting. Of course, the result can be saved as a Seka source file.

sentences.en: Here's another type of sine precalculator, called The Sinus Creator.
sentences.zh: 这是另一种类型的正弦预计算器，称为“正弦创建器”。

sentences.en: I have no idea if the numbers I've entered in the screenshot make sense, but the two-window text interface is interesting.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我在屏幕截图中输入的数字是否有意义，但两个窗口的文本界面很有趣。

sentences.en: Of course, the result can be saved as a Seka source file.
sentences.zh: 当然，结果可以保存为Seka源文件。

blocks.html_en: Music Trackers

sentences.en: Music Trackers
sentences.zh: 音乐追踪器

blocks.html_en: Demo music has historically been made in trackers. Far from traditional notation, a tracker lets the musician enter tones along with various modifiers and effects in something that's more reminiscent of a programming editor rather than regular composing. They also let the user manage instruments, whether sampled or synthesized.

sentences.en: Demo music has historically been made in trackers.
sentences.zh: 演示音乐历来都是在追踪器中制作的。

sentences.en: Far from traditional notation, a tracker lets the musician enter tones along with various modifiers and effects in something that's more reminiscent of a programming editor rather than regular composing.
sentences.zh: 与传统的记谱法不同，跟踪器允许音乐家输入音调以及各种修饰符和效果，这更让人想起编程编辑器而不是常规作曲。

sentences.en: They also let the user manage instruments, whether sampled or synthesized.
sentences.zh: 它们还允许用户管理乐器，无论是采样的还是合成的。

blocks.html_en: Sample-based trackers on the Amiga have an even more sprawling family tree than that of Amiga assemblers, but they all originate from Karsten Obarski's commercial Ultimate Soundtracker from 1987. Being commercial and thus costing money, it was soon picked apart by sceners, which resulted in NoiseTracker, which was then revamped into ProTracker, which in turn exists in so many various versions and re-hashed hacks that it's nigh impossible to keep track (heh) of. The sprawl is even sprawlier than that of Amiga assemblers!

sentences.en: Sample-based trackers on the Amiga have an even more sprawling family tree than that of Amiga assemblers, but they all originate from Karsten Obarski's commercial Ultimate Soundtracker from 1987.
sentences.zh: Amiga 上基于样本的跟踪器比 Amiga 汇编器的谱系更加庞大，但它们都源自 Karsten Obarski 1987 年的商业 Ultimate Soundtracker。

sentences.en: Being commercial and thus costing money, it was soon picked apart by sceners, which resulted in NoiseTracker, which was then revamped into ProTracker, which in turn exists in so many various versions and re-hashed hacks that it's nigh impossible to keep track (heh) of.
sentences.zh: 由于是商业性的，因此需要花钱，它很快就被场景爱好者们拆散了，这产生了 NoiseTracker，然后又被改造成 ProTracker，而 ProTracker 又存在于如此多的不同版本和重新哈希的黑客中，几乎不可能跟踪（嘿）。

sentences.en: The sprawl is even sprawlier than that of Amiga assemblers!
sentences.zh: 这种蔓延甚至比 Amiga 组装商的蔓延还要蔓延！

blocks.html_en: SoundMonitor 1.0 for the Commodore 64 (by Chris Huelsbeck) isn't strictly speaking a scene release, and wasn't called "tracker". However, the interface (with one "track" per available sound channel) is what inspired the previously mentioned Ultimate Soundtracker, and is thus included here for posterity and correctness.

sentences.en: SoundMonitor 1.0 for the Commodore 64 (by Chris Huelsbeck) isn't strictly speaking a scene release, and wasn't called "tracker".
sentences.zh: Commodore 64 的 SoundMonitor 1.0（由 Chris Huelsbeck 开发）严格来说并不是场景发布，也不被称为“跟踪器”。

sentences.en: However, the interface (with one "track" per available sound channel) is what inspired the previously mentioned Ultimate Soundtracker, and is thus included here for posterity and correctness.
sentences.zh: 然而，该界面（每个可用声道有一个“轨道”）是前面提到的 Ultimate Soundtracker 的灵感来源，因此包含在此处是为了后代和正确性。

blocks.html_en: NoiseTracker by the Swedish duo Mahoney and Kaktus wasn't the first, but it was immensely popular and came to define the tracker experience for years to come. Its legacy lives on just not in Protracker on the Amiga, but on several other platforms as well.

sentences.en: NoiseTracker by the Swedish duo Mahoney and Kaktus wasn't the first, but it was immensely popular and came to define the tracker experience for years to come.
sentences.zh: 瑞典二人组 Mahoney 和 Kaktus 开发的 NoiseTracker 并不是第一个，但它非常受欢迎，并定义了未来几年的跟踪器体验。

sentences.en: Its legacy lives on just not in Protracker on the Amiga, but on several other platforms as well.
sentences.zh: 它的遗产不仅存在于 Amiga 上的 Protracker 中，还存在于其他几个平台上。

blocks.html_en: Here's Protracker's file picker. Just like in NoiseTracker above, it's accessed by clicking the "Disk Op." button in the rather dense interface. It's hard to describe what a strange experience this UI delivers, because it's almost - but not quite - intuitive to someone used to more mainstream Amiga programs. It's easy to misclick, misunderstand or just plain miss things. To illustrate its idiosyncratic design, take note of the vertical EXIT button, which quits back to the main menu. It's conveniently placed between the up and down arrows used for scrolling the purple file and directory listing.

sentences.en: Here's Protracker's file picker.
sentences.zh: 这是 Protracker 的文件选择器。

sentences.en: Just like in NoiseTracker above, it's accessed by clicking the "Disk Op."
sentences.zh: 就像上面的 NoiseTracker 一样，可以通过单击“磁盘操作”来访问它。

sentences.en: button in the rather dense interface.
sentences.zh: 按钮在相当密集的界面中。

sentences.en: It's hard to describe what a strange experience this UI delivers, because it's almost - but not quite - intuitive to someone used to more mainstream Amiga programs.
sentences.zh: 很难描述这个 UI 提供了多么奇怪的体验，因为对于习惯了更主流 Amiga 程序的人来说，它几乎（但不是完全）直观。

sentences.en: It's easy to misclick, misunderstand or just plain miss things.
sentences.zh: 很容易误按、误解或只是错过一些事情。

sentences.en: To illustrate its idiosyncratic design, take note of the vertical EXIT button, which quits back to the main menu.
sentences.zh: 为了说明其独特的设计，请注意垂直的 EXIT 按钮，该按钮可退出回到主菜单。

sentences.en: It's conveniently placed between the up and down arrows used for scrolling the purple file and directory listing.
sentences.zh: 它方便地放置在用于滚动紫色文件和目录列表的向上和向下箭头之间。

blocks.html_en: Here's Digicomposer 1.0 for the Atari ST/e, which in turn builds on Noisetracker for the Atari. The interface is clearly more than just inspired by its Amiga counterpart. It's but one of a whole menagerie of trackers for the Atari ST, some "digi" (sample-based) like this one, some for YM-chip based music.

sentences.en: Here's Digicomposer 1.0 for the Atari ST/e, which in turn builds on Noisetracker for the Atari.
sentences.zh: 这是 Atari ST/e 的 Digicomposer 1.0，它又构建于 Atari 的 Noisetracker 之上。

sentences.en: The interface is clearly more than just inspired by its Amiga counterpart.
sentences.zh: 该界面显然不仅仅是受到 Amiga 界面的启发。

sentences.en: It's but one of a whole menagerie of trackers for the Atari ST, some "digi" (sample-based) like this one, some for YM-chip based music.
sentences.zh: 它只是 Atari ST 的一整套追踪器之一，有些是像这个这样的“digi”（基于样本的），有些是用于基于 YM 芯片的音乐。

blocks.html_en: Fasttracker II for MS-DOS is iconic in its own right. With support for Gravis UltraSound and other advanced PC sound hardware, it has features for 16-bit samples, bizarre amounts of sound channels, and even lets the user play a simple version of Snake if they so desire.

sentences.en: Fasttracker II for MS-DOS is iconic in its own right.
sentences.zh: Fasttracker II for MS-DOS 本身就是标志性的。

sentences.en: With support for Gravis UltraSound and other advanced PC sound hardware, it has features for 16-bit samples, bizarre amounts of sound channels, and even lets the user play a simple version of Snake if they so desire.
sentences.zh: 它支持 Gravis UltraSound 和其他先进的 PC 声音硬件，具有 16 位采样、数量惊人的声道的功能，甚至可以让用户播放简单版本的 Snake（如果他们愿意）。

blocks.html_en: Abyss' Highest Experience is a chiptune tracker for the Amiga, intended to sound like the Commodore 64's SID chip. The user interface is an interesting crossover between Soundtracker and a more modern, Workbench 2.0-like look.

sentences.en: Abyss' Highest Experience is a chiptune tracker for the Amiga, intended to sound like the Commodore 64's SID chip.
sentences.zh: Abyss' Highest Experience 是 Amiga 的芯片音乐跟踪器，旨在听起来像 Commodore 64 的 SID 芯片。

sentences.en: The user interface is an interesting crossover between Soundtracker and a more modern, Workbench 2.0-like look.
sentences.zh: 用户界面是 Soundtracker 和更现代、类似 Workbench 2.0 的外观之间的有趣交叉。

blocks.html_en: I don't know much about Megatizer for the Atari ST, but it sure does look cool!

sentences.en: I don't know much about Megatizer for the Atari ST, but it sure does look cool!
sentences.zh: 我对 Atari ST 的 Megatizer 了解不多，但它看起来确实很酷！

blocks.html_en: JamCrackerPro for the Amiga eschewed the traditional tracker UI and opted for a system-friendly, multi-window interface.

sentences.en: JamCrackerPro for the Amiga eschewed the traditional tracker UI and opted for a system-friendly, multi-window interface.
sentences.zh: Amiga 的 JamCrackerPro 避开了传统的跟踪器 UI，选择了系统友好的多窗口界面。

blocks.html_en: Disk Copiers

sentences.en: Disk Copiers
sentences.zh: 磁盘复印机

blocks.html_en: In order to distribute demos (and pirated software), disk copying was a common activity on the scene. Commodore provided a disk copier in AmigaOS, but it wasn't always up to the task of copying demos and games that bypassed the file system by writing directly to the tracks of a floppy. Thus, special software was needed!

sentences.en: In order to distribute demos (and pirated software), disk copying was a common activity on the scene.
sentences.zh: 为了分发演示（和盗版软件），磁盘复制是现场的常见活动。

sentences.en: Commodore provided a disk copier in AmigaOS, but it wasn't always up to the task of copying demos and games that bypassed the file system by writing directly to the tracks of a floppy.
sentences.zh: Commodore 在 AmigaOS 中提供了一个磁盘复制器，但它并不总是能够完成通过直接写入软盘磁道来绕过文件系统复制演示和游戏的任务。

sentences.en: Thus, special software was needed!
sentences.zh: 因此，需要特殊的软件！

blocks.html_en: Like SoundMonitor, X-Copy isn't strictly a scene release. Although originally written by sceners, it was released commercially and then heavily pirated on the scene. The prominently featured grids contain one square for each track on the disk, displaying the status for copying that particular part of the floppy. When a copy was finished (which could take some time), the program helpfully played a little "boing" sound.

sentences.en: Like SoundMonitor, X-Copy isn't strictly a scene release.
sentences.zh: 与 SoundMonitor 一样，X-Copy 严格来说并不是场景发布。

sentences.en: Although originally written by sceners, it was released commercially and then heavily pirated on the scene.
sentences.zh: 虽然最初是由场景创作者编写的，但它被商业发行，然后在场景中被大量盗版。

sentences.en: The prominently featured grids contain one square for each track on the disk, displaying the status for copying that particular part of the floppy.
sentences.zh: 突出的网格包含磁盘上每个磁道的一个方块，显示复制软盘特定部分的状态。

sentences.en: When a copy was finished (which could take some time), the program helpfully played a little "boing" sound.
sentences.zh: 当副本完成时（这可能需要一些时间），程序会播放一些“嗡嗡”声。

blocks.html_en: X-Copy was released in many versions during the Amiga heydays. Here's X-Copy 3.0, apparently in an illicit variety distributed by the cracking group Paradox.

sentences.en: X-Copy was released in many versions during the Amiga heydays.
sentences.zh: X-Copy 在 Amiga 全盛时期发布了多个版本。

sentences.en: Here's X-Copy 3.0, apparently in an illicit variety distributed by the cracking group Paradox.
sentences.zh: 这是 X-Copy 3.0，显然是破解组织 Paradox 分发的非法变体。

blocks.html_en: Personally, I preferred D-Copy, mostly because I thought the user interface looked cool (and I still do). It is, as far as I know, a bona fide non-commercial scene product.

sentences.en: Personally, I preferred D-Copy, mostly because I thought the user interface looked cool (and I still do).
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言，我更喜欢 D-Copy，主要是因为我认为用户界面看起来很酷（现在仍然如此）。

sentences.en: It is, as far as I know, a bona fide non-commercial scene product.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，这是一个真正的非商业场景产品。

blocks.html_en: Other Tools

sentences.en: Other Tools
sentences.zh: 其他工具

blocks.html_en: A short article like this can only ever scratch the surface of the numerous demo scene tools ever created. Here are but a few more various tools and interfaces, selected for being interesting and/or representative of their kind.

sentences.en: A short article like this can only ever scratch the surface of the numerous demo scene tools ever created.
sentences.zh: 像这样的短文只能触及有史以来创建的众多演示场景工具的表面。

sentences.en: Here are but a few more various tools and interfaces, selected for being interesting and/or representative of their kind.
sentences.zh: 这里仅列出了一些其他不同的工具和界面，它们是因为有趣和/或具有代表性而被选择的。

blocks.html_en: This is Titanics Cruncher for the Amiga. A cruncher uses asymmetrical compression of executable files. This saves space on disk, with the tradeoff being longer loading times, due to the decrunching (decompression) of the executable upon running it. Several other crunchers exist, and on a variety of platforms.

sentences.en: This is Titanics Cruncher for the Amiga.
sentences.zh: 这是 Amiga 的泰坦尼克号粉碎机。

sentences.en: A cruncher uses asymmetrical compression of executable files.
sentences.zh: 压缩器使用可执行文件的非对称压缩。

sentences.en: This saves space on disk, with the tradeoff being longer loading times, due to the decrunching (decompression) of the executable upon running it.

sentences.en: Several other crunchers exist, and on a variety of platforms.
sentences.zh: 存在其他几个处理程序，并且在各种平台上。

blocks.html_en: Before the Internet, there was the Bulletin Board System, or BBS. Sceners were usually interested in Elite BBS:es, meaning ones that offered pirated software for download. There were few, if any, Elite BBS:es without cool ANSI (or PETSCII, on the C64) graphics, for example in animated menu screens. Thus, many various ANSI editors popped up for different platforms. This is Digital Intelligence's Ansi-Editor v2.4 for the Amiga, and it has a very peculiar user interface. The toolbar at the bottom displays the currently active colours, but you can't select them from there. Click all you want, to no effect - you have to use the pull-down menu to actually pick one.

sentences.en: There were few, if any, Elite BBS:es without cool ANSI (or PETSCII, on the C64) graphics, for example in animated menu screens.
sentences.zh: 很少有精英 BBS 没有酷炫的 ANSI（或 PETSCII，在 C64 上）图形，例如动画菜单屏幕。

sentences.en: Thus, many various ANSI editors popped up for different platforms.
sentences.zh: 因此，针对不同平台出现了许多不同的 ANSI 编辑器。

sentences.en: This is Digital Intelligence's Ansi-Editor v2.4 for the Amiga, and it has a very peculiar user interface.
sentences.zh: 这是 Digital Intelligence 的 Amiga 的 Ansi-Editor v2.4，它有一个非常奇特的用户界面。

sentences.en: The toolbar at the bottom displays the currently active colours, but you can't select them from there.
sentences.zh: 底部的工具栏显示当前活动的颜色，但您无法从那里选择它们。

content_html_zh:
探索贸易工具

July 2026

啊，演示场景 - 数字艺术亚文化，一群形形色色的创意书呆子，以及我最喜欢的消遣。 场景设计师创作了如此多令人惊叹的艺术、音乐和代码，任何接触过场景的人都可能会开始想知道到底是如何制作的——当然，除了数小时的专注研究之外。

该场景拥有构建自己的工具的悠久而传奇的传统。 有时是从头开始，有时是从现有产品中窃取想法甚至代码。 由于青少年缺乏经验、陈旧习惯、喜欢尝试以及想让事情看起来很酷的愿望，这导致了一些相当奇特的用户界面。

下面介绍其中的一些。 其中大多数适用于 Amiga，但也有其他几个平台。

精英窦制作人

不想被指责为点击诱饵，让我们从主要景点之一开始：Elite Sinus Producer（这里的 sinus 应该理解为正弦），由 Ipec Elite 为 Amiga 制作。 演示通常被描述为“实时”，这是事实，因为它们（几乎）不仅仅是动画播放器，而且演示效果是由代码逐帧生成的。 然而，为了实现看似不可能的技术壮举，却采用了广泛的“作弊”手段。 最常见的作弊可能是所谓的预计算，这意味着不是在 7 MHz（或更慢）的 CPU 上进行复杂的数学运算，而是利用查找表。 存在大量用于创建此类查找表的工具。 这是其中之一。

首次启动 Elite Sinus Producer 时，用户会看到此菜单。 按 F 键进行选择后，相应的菜单选项会突出显示，并会播放布谷鸟钟的样本。 高声。

这里我选择了“花”选项。 漂亮，不是吗？ 然后可以将其作为（大概）汇编源代码保存到磁盘。 任何精灵沿着这条路径移动时都会看起来很漂亮！

还有一个方便的帮助屏幕，它太奇怪了，我不得不抓起它的一个短片：背景的一部分由移动的蓝色光栅条组成，另一部分在红色和青色之间闪烁。 显然，这在阅读文本时非常有帮助，因为文本显示的字体设计时只考虑了易读性。

基于文本的界面

许多场景相关工具要么是命令行实用程序，要么主要基于文本。 首先，我们有汇编器。 Amiga 有各种各样的汇编器，但现场总是青睐 Seka、Asm-One 和同一概念的其他衍生产品。 有如此多不同的版本和 hack（例如 Trash'm-one），其庞大的家谱可与 Unix 系统相媲美。

这是 Seka 2.0，正如我们所看到的，它基于商业汇编器。 这种类型的汇编器总是询问用户要分配的工作内存的大小。 然后，他们进入命令行模式，该模式可用于检查 RAM 内存和 CPU 寄存器，并将源文件加载到适当的编辑器中。

这是 AsmOne 的众多化身之一。 它与 Seka 非常相似（事实上，它是“Seka-Updated”），但有更多内置命令，大概还有其他改进（我从来都不是一个编码员）。 从界面角度来看，它会打开自己的屏幕，而不是在默认工作台屏幕上的窗口中运行。

如果您在游戏中发现一段很酷的音乐或图形怎么办？ 如果您想窃取一些样本或精灵，或者只是保存整首曲子以便于聆听，该怎么办？ 然后你需要一个开膛手 - 一种在计算机内存中搜寻的工具，在退出游戏后寻找此类数据的残留物。 Amiga 的此类撕裂器有很多。 这是 Multi-Ripper，它具有一组相当有代表性的功能。

这是另一种类型的开膛手，专门为在计算机崩溃后在内存中查找 Seka 汇编源而编写。 Amiga 与大多数其他家用电脑一样，没有内存保护，而且演示编码是出了名的容易崩溃的活动。 经常保存是常见的做法，但即使是经验丰富的程序员有时也会搞砸并忘记。 运气好的话，在热重启后可以从内存中提取代码。

这是另一种类型的正弦预计算器，称为“正弦创建器”。 我不知道我在屏幕截图中输入的数字是否有意义，但两个窗口的文本界面很有趣。 当然，结果可以保存为Seka源文件。

音乐追踪器

演示音乐历来都是在追踪器中制作的。 与传统的记谱法不同，跟踪器允许音乐家输入音调以及各种修饰符和效果，这更让人想起编程编辑器而不是常规作曲。 它们还允许用户管理乐器，无论是采样的还是合成的。

Amiga 上基于样本的跟踪器比 Amiga 汇编器的谱系更加庞大，但它们都源自 Karsten Obarski 1987 年的商业 Ultimate Soundtracker。 由于是商业性的，因此需要花钱，它很快就被场景爱好者们拆散了，这产生了 NoiseTracker，然后又被改造成 ProTracker，而 ProTracker 又存在于如此多的不同版本和重新哈希的黑客中，几乎不可能跟踪（嘿）。 这种蔓延甚至比 Amiga 组装商的蔓延还要蔓延！

Commodore 64 的 SoundMonitor 1.0（由 Chris Huelsbeck 开发）严格来说并不是场景发布，也不被称为“跟踪器”。 然而，该界面（每个可用声道有一个“轨道”）是前面提到的 Ultimate Soundtracker 的灵感来源，因此包含在此处是为了后代和正确性。

瑞典二人组 Mahoney 和 Kaktus 开发的 NoiseTracker 并不是第一个，但它非常受欢迎，并定义了未来几年的跟踪器体验。 它的遗产不仅存在于 Amiga 上的 Protracker 中，还存在于其他几个平台上。

这是 Protracker 的文件选择器。 就像上面的 NoiseTracker 一样，可以通过单击“磁盘操作”来访问它。 按钮在相当密集的界面中。 很难描述这个 UI 提供了多么奇怪的体验，因为对于习惯了更主流 Amiga 程序的人来说，它几乎（但不是完全）直观。 很容易误按、误解或只是错过一些事情。 为了说明其独特的设计，请注意垂直的 EXIT 按钮，该按钮可退出回到主菜单。 它方便地放置在用于滚动紫色文件和目录列表的向上和向下箭头之间。

这是 Atari ST/e 的 Digicomposer 1.0，它又构建于 Atari 的 Noisetracker 之上。 该界面显然不仅仅是受到 Amiga 界面的启发。 它只是 Atari ST 的一整套追踪器之一，有些是像这个这样的“digi”（基于样本的），有些是用于基于 YM 芯片的音乐。

Fasttracker II for MS-DOS 本身就是标志性的。 它支持 Gravis UltraSound 和其他先进的 PC 声音硬件，具有 16 位采样、数量惊人的声道的功能，甚至可以让用户播放简单版本的 Snake（如果他们愿意）。

Abyss' Highest Experience 是 Amiga 的芯片音乐跟踪器，旨在听起来像 Commodore 64 的 SID 芯片。 用户界面是 Soundtracker 和更现代、类似 Workbench 2.0 的外观之间的有趣交叉。

我对 Atari ST 的 Megatizer 了解不多，但它看起来确实很酷！

Amiga 的 JamCrackerPro 避开了传统的跟踪器 UI，选择了系统友好的多窗口界面。

磁盘复印机

为了分发演示（和盗版软件），磁盘复制是现场的常见活动。 Commodore 在 AmigaOS 中提供了一个磁盘复制器，但它并不总是能够完成通过直接写入软盘磁道来绕过文件系统复制演示和游戏的任务。 因此，需要特殊的软件！

与 SoundMonitor 一样，X-Copy 严格来说并不是场景发布。 虽然最初是由场景创作者编写的，但它被商业发行，然后在场景中被大量盗版。 突出的网格包含磁盘上每个磁道的一个方块，显示复制软盘特定部分的状态。 当副本完成时（这可能需要一些时间），程序会播放一些“嗡嗡”声。

X-Copy 在 Amiga 全盛时期发布了多个版本。 这是 X-Copy 3.0，显然是破解组织 Paradox 分发的非法变体。

就我个人而言，我更喜欢 D-Copy，主要是因为我认为用户界面看起来很酷（现在仍然如此）。 据我所知，这是一个真正的非商业场景产品。

其他工具

像这样的短文只能触及有史以来创建的众多演示场景工具的表面。 这里仅列出了一些其他不同的工具和界面，它们是因为有趣和/或具有代表性而被选择的。

这是 Amiga 的泰坦尼克号粉碎机。 压缩器使用可执行文件的非对称压缩。 这可以节省磁盘空间，但代价是加载时间更长，因为运行可执行文件时会对其进行解压（解压缩）。 存在其他几个处理程序，并且在各种平台上。

在互联网出现之前，就有了公告板系统（BBS）。 现场观众通常对精英 BBS 感兴趣，即提供盗版软件下载的论坛。 很少有精英 BBS 没有酷炫的 ANSI（或 PETSCII，在 C64 上）图形，例如动画菜单屏幕。 因此，针对不同平台出现了许多不同的 ANSI 编辑器。 这是 Digital Intelligence 的 Amiga 的 Ansi-Editor v2.4，它有一个非常奇特的用户界面。 底部的工具栏显示当前活动的颜色，但您无法从那里选择它们。 单击您想要的所有内容，但没有效果 - 您必须使用下拉菜单来实际选择一个。

在 Twitter、Facebook、IRC 甚至调制解调器和 BBS 广泛使用之前，滚动文本是该场景选择的通信媒介。 酷滚动条需要酷字体，并且专用的字体（或字符集）编辑器可能会有所帮助。 这是 Escape 的 Charedit，适用于 MS-DOS。

家用计算机通常配备定制或其他深奥的硬件。 例如，Atari Falcon 就配备了 Motorola 56001 数字信号处理器。 tSCc（The Sirius Cyber​​netics Corporation 的缩写）的 DSPdit 是专为 DSP56k 编程而设计的编辑器和汇编器。 它使用标准的 GEM 工具包，这使其具有非常干净和专业的外观。

Amiga 的第一个计算机病毒是引导块病毒，它感染软盘的引导扇区。 因此，它可能会破坏带有自定义引导块的游戏和其他软盘。 它是由瑞士裂化协会 (SCA) 建造的。 病毒像野火一样蔓延，也许SCA受到了良心的困扰，因为后来他们还为Amiga制造了第一个病毒杀手——旨在对抗他们自己的病毒。 超级强大的界面很容易掌握！

如上所述，大量 Amiga 演示版被称为 trackmos，这意味着它们不使用文件系统，而是直接将数据存储在软盘的磁道上。 这很快导致各种工具可用于创建此类 trackmos。 大多数情况下，它只是场景设计者之间共享的代码，但也有完整的软件套件，例如 Poison of NOVA 的 TrackmoDOS。 除此之外，它还附带了这个正统的文件管理器，用于将文件写入和删除到 trackmo 软盘。 作为一个场景工具，GUI 当然具有一些相当漂亮的颜色渐变。

这是RAW，它并不是真正的工具，而是磁盘杂志或diskmag。 Diskmag 就是在一张或多张软盘上出版的期刊。 大多数文章通常与场景相关，尽管有些杂志还进行了扩展，涵盖从短篇小说、诗歌到有关历史和政治的文章等各种内容。 RAW 是 20 世纪 90 年代初期最受欢迎的 Amiga 磁盘杂志之一，正如我们所见，早在 Frutiger Aero 出现之前，其 UI 就已经闪亮且有质感。 它甚至配备了内置的调色板编辑器（如图），允许用户自定义文本颜色。

这是 FuckPaint，Atari Falcon 的像素画家。 它被包含在这里只是因为它的名字和它同样优雅的“分析器”工具的优点。

虽然根本不是场景制作，但这里不得不提的是Deluxe Paint。 据我所知，该场景从未为 Amiga 生成像素画家（除了后来的 Grafx2 端口），大概是因为没有人认为有必要。 我认为没有一个 Amiga 用户没有该软件的副本，无论是单独购买、与机器捆绑在一起还是只是盗版。 它在 PC 上也完全占据主导地位。 还有其他 Amiga 像素画家，例如 Brilliance 和 Personal Paint，但它们的总市场份额只是这个巨头的一小部分，而这个巨头在 20 世纪 90 年代中期也主导了游戏的图形创作。
